message: @everyone I’m setting up a group specifically for those who want to participate in roleplay videos. People here have mentioned how much they dislike being pinged, so if you’d like to join this group, please reach out to me. Let’s move forward with a few select people—I’ll be assigning special roles during my streams to those who join. As I head toward the 20,000-subscriber milestone, I want to continue this journey with the right group of people.
